producer_report.summary: Root cause: cited job ids in the reader brief were resolved only to the job's request and findings, never to its recorded reading and deliverables, so readings invented the cited jobs' shape for thresholds and fixtures. Fixed in referenced_jobs_section (athena-context): each referenced job now prints its recorded reading summary, criteria (with count) and deliverables (with count), or "no reading recorded". The section tells the reader to take sizes, thresholds and fixtures from those deliverables. Added 3 tests and a CHANGELOG entry. No refusal rule added.

criteria_check.criterion: The root cause is named in the doc comment of referenced_jobs_section in crates/athena-context/src/briefs/reader.rs: cited job ids were resolved only to request and findings, not to recorded deliverables.
criteria_check.evidence: Doc comment above referenced_jobs_section in reader.rs begins 'Root cause this section removes: cited job ids were resolved only to the job's request and findings, not to its recorded deliverables'.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-context referenced`: a new test builds a reader brief with a referenced job that has reading_summary, reading_criteria and reading_deliverables set, and asserts the Referenced jobs section lists each deliverable and a deliverable count; the test fails on the old code and passes with the change.
criteria_check.evidence: Test briefs::tests::referenced_jobs_list_recorded_deliverables_with_a_count sets all three fields, asserts each of 3 deliverables as '> ...' lines plus 'Recorded deliverables (3):'. Ran cargo test -p athena-context referenced: passes. On old code the section has no such text (old function printed only request and findings), so the asserts fail.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-context referenced`: a test with referenced jobs having no recorded reading asserts the section says 'no reading recorded' for them, and the existing reader_briefs_carry_referenced_jobs_only_when_set assertions still hold.
criteria_check.evidence: referenced_jobs_without_a_reading_say_so asserts 2 occurrences; reader_briefs_carry_referenced_jobs_only_when_set passes in the same run.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-context`: a test shows a referenced job that is also the retried job or followed up is not printed twice with deliverables, and no new line starts with 'Job ' beyond the one per job.
criteria_check.evidence: referenced_job_deliverables_are_not_repeated_for_the_retried_job: retried deliverable appears once (in Earlier attempt), not in Referenced jobs section; section has exactly one line starting 'Job '. Passes.

criteria_check.criterion: The brief tells the reader to take sizes, thresholds and test fixtures for rules citing those jobs from the listed recorded deliverables; the wording is in reader.rs and stays inside the reader prompt token budget (no prompt file edit).
criteria_check.evidence: Section intro in reader.rs now says 'take its sizes, thresholds and test fixtures from the deliverables listed here, not from an assumed shape'; asserted in the first new test. No prompt file edited. The addition is one sentence.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test`: all pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased entry naming the cause and the fix.
criteria_check.evidence: CHANGELOG.md Unreleased > Changed has an entry beginning 'The reader brief's "Referenced jobs" section now prints each cited job's recorded reading' with 'Cause: ...'.

learnings: EarlierAttempt already carries reading_summary/criteria/deliverables for referenced jobs; only the brief rendering omitted them.
